title: Consolidation pass when dictation stops (unified note generation)

test_cases.name: Consolidation triggered on session stop
test_cases.input_setup: Receive 5 incremental fragments followed by stop event
test_cases.expected_result: Consolidation merges all fragments into single unified note
test_cases.evidence: Consolidation executed on session stop; generated unified clinical note

test_cases.name: Consolidation latency bound (<= 3 s)
test_cases.input_setup: Execute final note consolidation and measure processing duration
test_cases.expected_result: Final note produced within <= 3.0 s of stop event

test_cases.name: Information preservation during consolidation
test_cases.input_setup: Compare segment findings against final consolidated model
test_cases.expected_result: 100% of recorded segment findings present in consolidated note
test_cases.evidence: Zero information loss: all findings from incoming segments preserved in final note

test_cases.name: Deduplication across segments
test_cases.input_setup: Consolidate segments containing repeated medical mentions
test_cases.expected_result: Duplicates removed; finding mentioned exactly once in final note
test_cases.evidence: Deduplication confirmed: redundant repetitive mentions consolidated to single entry

test_cases.name: Zero-segment stop handling
test_cases.input_setup: Trigger stop event on empty session with zero recorded audio segments
test_cases.expected_result: Returns empty schema cleanly; zero application exceptions
test_cases.evidence: Zero-segment stop handled gracefully without crash
